doc.title: Fred Staton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 12, 2008

title: Next president and the state of the country
summary: He has no prediction for the election and fears the country is corrupt.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Politics, race and the state of the country

blocks.x: Yeah. Do you have a prediction about who will be our next president?
No. I don’t have a clue.
It’s something, huh. Do you have a favorite?
I did, but now it’s — I’m on the fence. And of course the reasons I’m just so afraid, the country is so corrupt. A person gets up so high and we shoot them down.
